text: This is a great clinic. They give good advice, don't push sales, and are very patient. The doctor is incredibly kind. As someone who suffers from panic attacks and is terrified of dentists, I'd rate this doctor as number one. The doctor kept reassuring me during the procedure, even though I had to sit up and stand up frequently due to my panic attacks. They were so patient and understanding. If you plan to visit, I recommend booking an appointment in advance. Even though it seems quiet, the doctor is very busy!

She's a doctor with high medical ethics. She doesn't push patients to spend extra on unnecessary things and provides accurate information about dental health. Clinics with doctors like hers are very rare these days.
You are a fantastic dentist who is very attentive to your patients. There are no extra charges, only improved care.
